instruction: Set the auto-save interval to 5 minutes in LibreOffice Impress.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully navigated to Tools > Options > Load/Save > General, enabled auto-save checkbox, changed interval from 10 to 3 minutes, and clicked OK.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice menus, open Options dialog, navigate dialog tree, enable checkboxes, change numeric spinbox values, confirm with OK
metadata.task_rationale: Same pattern as original but with different auto-save interval value (5 min instead of 3 min) to verify the model can generalize the setting change.
metadata.explanation: Task requires setting auto-save to 5 minutes. Evaluator reuses official check_auto_saving_time metric which parses registrymodifications.xcu for the AutoSaveTimeIntervall value.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches registrymodifications.xcu from the VM, which is the standard LibreOffice configuration file storing user setting changes.

Metric check_auto_saving_time correctly parses the XCU XML, locating AutoSaveTimeIntervall under /org.openoffice.Office.Common/Save/Document and comparing its integer value against the expected minutes.
Expected value rules.minutes=5 matches the instruction requirement of 5 minutes.
Rule-type expected is correctly handled: get_rule returns {'minutes': 5} directly, and the metric accesses rules['minutes'] without incorrect nesting.
Full instruction coverage: the instruction asks to set the auto-save interval, and the evaluator checks exactly that interval value.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider also verifying that auto-save is enabled (AutoSaveEnabled property) in addition to the interval, since setting an interval without enabling auto-save would be incomplete. However, the instruction specifically says 'interval', so this is not strictly required.
